page_title: UNI 1-2 HEI | Union Berlin v Heidenheim 29/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.

90+5' 1 - 2 The score has changed – 1:2. Arijon Ibrahimovic sends a fantastic cross into the box from the corner. Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) jumps highest and plants a header down inside the right post.
90+5' There's an opportunity for Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
90+4' An attempted cross from Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) is cleared.
90+3' The linesman raises his flag. Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) is adjudged offside.
90+2' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' 1 - 1 Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) receives a precise pass inside the box from Omar Haktab Traore and he beats the goalkeeper with a neat finish into the right side of the net. 1:1.
89' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
87' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Heidenheim, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

87' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Heidenheim.
84' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) is penalised for a foul. Patrick Ittrich had a clear view and blows his whistle.
82' A long pass finds Julian Niehues (Heidenheim) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post.
79' Steffen Baumgart has decided to make a change. Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) replaces Christopher Trimmel.
79' Substitution. Aljoscha Kemlein did his best and is replaced by Andras Schafer (Union Berlin).
79' A corner kick by Heidenheim is thwarted by the well prepared Frederik Ronnow (Union Berlin).
78' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim have been awarded a corner kick.
77' The attendance for today's match is 22012.
76' Substitution. Mathias Honsak leaves the pitch and is replaced by Yannik Wagner (Heidenheim).
76' Frank Schmidt has decided to substitute Marnon Busch and he is replaced by Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim).
75' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
74' Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
73' Steffen Baumgart prepares a substitution. Woo-Yeong Jeong is replaced by Alex Kral (Union Berlin).
73' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) is coming onto the pitch as Derrick Kohn cannot continue after picking up an injury.
72' Patrick Ittrich shows the yellow card to Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin) for a heavy challenge.
71' The corner is swung in but Union Berlin can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
70' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
70' Heidenheim failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

69' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) rises high to meet a cross from the corner kick and plants a header from inside the penalty area. His effort went just narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
68' Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) takes the corner.
68' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin). Union Berlin have been awarded a corner kick.
66' Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Patrick Ittrich ignores the protests.
64' Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the left post.
64' Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Diant Ramaj, who smothers the ball.
62' Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
61' Today's match ends for Oliver Burke who will be replaced by Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin).
57' We are about to witness a substitution. Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) is replacing Adrian Beck.
57' Frank Schmidt has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) replacing Benedikt Gimber.
57' The substitution has been made. Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) has replaced Niklas Dorsch.
55' Patrick Ittrich blows his whistle. Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) commits a foul after dangerous play.
52' Diant Ramaj displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
51' Union Berlin enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
49' Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
46' A yellow card for a tackle by Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim). Patrick Ittrich doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
46' Referee Patrick Ittrich blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
45+3' Neat passing move from Heidenheim in order to create new attacking opportunities.
45' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
43' 1 - 0 Goal! Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the right post. He makes it 1:0.
39' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Union Berlin.
39' The ball is cleared after Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Union Berlin get a corner.
38' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Patrick Ittrich blows for a foul.
36' The game is interrupted. Julian Niehues (Heidenheim) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
35' A raking crossfield pass from Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
35' Patrick Ittrich couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Julian Niehues (Heidenheim) and blew his whistle.
33' The foul by Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin) was seen by Patrick Ittrich who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
32' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
30' The resulting corner, taken by Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin), comes to nothing.
29' Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Union Berlin.
28' Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
23' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
22' Julian Niehues (Heidenheim) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
22' Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
18' Julian Niehues (Heidenheim) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
17' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
16' Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and Union Berlin manage to earn a corner.
13' The referee Patrick Ittrich awards Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) a yellow card.
12' Heidenheim take a short corner kick.

10' Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort crashes against the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
8' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
6' Union Berlin are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
2' The Heidenheim players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
